messages: Anya R: Quick design review 1 compact streaming chat iterate. Focus: live-stream affordance, inline token counter copy, stop/regenerate naming, keyboard shortcuts, and a11y behavior. Mockup: https://redwood.in/drive/playground-compact-v4.png Sam D: I like the tighter rail. Question: should the action be "Stop" or something softer like "Interrupt"? "Stop" reads final. Lucas P: Runtime POV: "Interrupt" aligns with canceling the in-flight request; "Stop" can imply the model is gone. If we have a quick regen, "Interrupt" + "Regenerate" makes sense. Maggie (A11y): A11y concerns: token counter updates every chunk will create a lot of noise for screen readers. Use aria-live="polite" but debounce announcements. Also ensure the interrupt control is tabbable and exposes state (aria-label and role/status). Tooltips must be keyboard-focusable. Nate C: Implementation thought: keep visual counter updating per chunk. For SRs, debounce to announce only when count changes by >=50 or on completion. Keyboard: map Esc to interrupt, Shift+Enter to regenerate. Agree? Sam D: Esc mapping feels intuitive. For copy, avoid "Pause" (implies resume). So "Interrupt" + "Regenerate" it is. Token label should be terse: "Tokens: 234". Tooltip to explain token vs char and link to docs. Maggie (A11y): Tooltip copy: say "Token estimates; billing tokens may differ. See docs for details." Use aria-describedby for the tooltip, and a role="status" message at end: "Generation complete 1 234 tokens". Also respect prefers-reduced-motion for the streaming pulse. Lucas P: Small perf note: debounced SR announces require a client-side mini state machine to batch updates. Also ensure KV-cache or prefix caching doesn't reorder the visible stream. Nate C: HTML sketch: ``` Tokens: 0 ``` We'll add tabindex where needed and manage SR announcements from JS. Sam D: Visual tweaks: subtle pulsing dot during streaming attached to the bubble; token counter sits under the bubble in small caps. For reduced-motion, remove pulsing. Consider contrast on the counter text. Maggie (A11y): Confirm color contrast for token counter (AA min). Font size ok at 12px if contrast passes. Also ensure keyboard focus order: message -> interrupt -> regen. Anya R: Agreed decisions: label = "Interrupt"; separate "Regenerate" action; token counter copy = "Tokens: N"; SR announce debounced (+threshold or end); keyboard: Esc = Interrupt, Shift+Enter = Regenerate; tooltip with docs link. Action items: Sam update mocks; Nate implement keyboard + aria; Lucas add batching hook; Maggie will QA with NVDA. design-bot: Created tasks: DESIGN-4212 update compact-playground mocks; ENGINE-9821 keyboard/a11y implementation; RESEARCH-330 a11y QA. :white_check_mark:
